## History

  

## Cat Trail is an investment company serving the Dekker family.

Cat Trail was founded by David Dekker after Marcel Dekker, Inc. was acquired at the end of 2003. Marcel Dekker, Inc. (Dekker) was a scientific/technological/medical (STM) publishing company founded by David and Russell's father, Marcel Dekker, in 1964. Prior, Marcel worked in marketing and sales for the publishing firm, Interscience, which was founded by Marcel's father, Maurits Dekker, and Eric Proskauer in 1947. Interscience merged with John Wiley & Sons in 1963, becoming Wiley-Interscience.

Like Interscience before it, Marcel Dekker, Inc. prospered, transforming into a mid-sized global STM publisher. In 1997, Marcel Dekker retained his Chairman title but vacated the Presidency, passing the company's leadership to his two sons, Russell Dekker as Chief Publishing Officer and David Dekker as Chief Operating Officer.

At the time, technology and the internet were posing both opportunities and challenges for traditional publishers. With new leadership, the company embraced the digital challenges by building a strong web presence, a new brand image, pioneering in-house content management, and directly publishing material in real-time to the web and syndication partners. Crossroads Media, a separate company owned by David and Russell Dekker, also purchased Achorn Graphics (Achorn) in 1998, a typesetter which had developed a unique technology to render STM content on the web. Achorn became well-regarded doing all production work for Dekker as well as for other STM publishers such as Elsevier, Kluwer, Springer, Wiley, and McGraw-Hill. Achorn was sold in 2001 to SPI Graphics, a company financed by Tommy Lee Partners.

In 2003, Dekker's Board of Directors agreed to sell Dekker to the Taylor & Francis Group, plc (T&F). Dekker's American base and digital activism made it an especially good fit with the more English and print-centric T&F. Russell and David worked for T&F, honoring their required employment contracts, but left soon after to establish new ventures. Now well-established and with better resources, Cat Trail has become a full-service investment boutique for the Dekker family.

Boutique and independent multi-family office. 
‘Ohana’ is the Hawaiian 
word for family. 
The meaning extends beyond one’s immediate home, to include relatives, friends, neighbors, and the community of people that you care about and that care about you. ‘Ohana’ informs all that we do for our families and team and community.
For over 25 years, Ohana has advised ultra-high net worth families on all aspects of their lives. We are trusted and deeply experienced investment managers conducting thorough diligence of diverse investment opportunities. We serve as confidants to families facing complex business, financial planning, and personal decisions. Our dedicated team oversees the myriad of administrative responsibilities that often come with significant wealth. Ohana’s extensive capabilities and suite of tailored services help our clients meet their ambitious personal and financial goals.

Our independence means our advice is free of competing interests. Our size allows for dedicated, senior level support.

Portfolio Management Services | Longwall Family Office
Many would simply refer to a family office as a private wealth management advisory firm that serves high-net-worth individuals and their families. 
But family offices are different from traditional wealth management firms since they usually look to provide a holistic solution to managing the financial and investment needs of an affluent family or individual. For example, in addition to investment management, family offices offer estate planning, charitable giving, investment education, insurance, and tax advice. In various forms and with various degrees of emphasis, Longwall Family Office also offers these services. But it is not just a bundle of services that defines the family office for the Longwall Partners. There is also an attitude, a style of operation, and a culture that is brought to bear on the various offerings of the Firm. 
At Longwall, we think that a family investment office should be a place where capital is managed with the utmost of care, professionalism, and competency, and where there is as much as practically possible a very close alignment of interests. To a family client at Longwall, it should not feel as if the Firm is an outside service provider dealing with their investments. Rather, it should feel as if client families are inside the office, working with and conversing with their own partners and experts, not at arms’ length but in an immediate and familiar fashion. The dialogues should be candid. The understanding of the family’s needs and particularities should be detailed and deep. There should be a great deal of back and forth. If a client wants to see the development of a particular investment plan or specific opportunity, as the due diligence is coming along, then that is what they should get. In this way, the investment recommendations and the choices that are ultimately made will be significantly stronger, and better understood. 
Finally, a word or two on “education” and on solid “alignment” within a family office setting. Clients of the Longwall Family Office are encouraged to learn as much as they can about the investment universe and about best practices in investing and portfolio management. The Longwall Partners have the skills and backgrounds to help on this score, and what is just as important, they greatly enjoy the educational aspects of the work they do, and enjoy the conversations about markets, risks, and opportunities. As for alignment, the Principals of the Firm like to invest alongside client capital where they can, to get as much alignment as can be achieved. While some people see such instances of co-investment as setting up potential conflicts of interest (and we can see how that could be so characterized) we see it quite differently and believe that it is ideal when a Longwall Partner is able to invest in the same holdings or opportunities as family clients. We, therefore, live with similar risks and rewards. From the perspective of the Longwall Family Office, these aspects of a family office offering are very good things, and we hope you might see the above features in a similar light.

# What We Do - Longwall Family Office

**We offer three distinct services:**

*    **Bespoke investment advisory**
*   **Tax-aware investment strategies**
*   **Fund management**

[DISCOVER](https://www.longwallfamilyoffice.com/)

![](https://irt-cdn.multiscreensite.com/md/dmtmpl/dms3rep/multi/Grunge_white_background.png)

## Investment Advisory

Longwall Family Office is a comprehensive investment advisor offering long-term, strategic portfolio management and bespoke wealth strategies tailored to the individual needs of each client. Our long-term commitment to clients ensures that our services are delivered with integrity, transparency, and discretion.

We provide a broad range of services, both directly and through our partners:

*   Review and analysis of existing holdings and portfolios
*   Development of “investment goals and constraints” charters
*   Custom portfolio design
*   Comprehensive due diligence on funds, securities, and private holdings
*   Ongoing risk monitoring
*   Investment education and guidance
*   Ownership succession planning
*   Estate and philanthropic planning advice
*   Tax optimization strategies for individuals, trusts, and estates  
    

## Tax-Aware Strategies

Tax-aware strategies are investment strategies designed to increase long-term wealth by minimizing taxes. As tax laws and regulations change, Longwall Family Office can create long-term financial plans that minimize your current and future tax liabilities. 

Our financial advisors take into account the risks associated with pretax returns which trail expectations, as well as potential losses and expenses from adverse changes in tax benefits. By carefully monitoring investments with a focus on long-term goals, we aim to provide optimal results for you and your family.

With our experience in Tax Aware Strategy investing, Longwall Family Office is uniquely positioned to help you make informed decisions when it comes to creating a secure financial future. Let us be your guide to navigating variable tax laws with confidence and long-term success. 

Contact Longwall Family Office to set up a consultation and begin developing a tax-aware strategy that suits your long-term needs. We look forward to serving you!  

## Fund Management

At Longwall Family Office, we provide comprehensive fund management services tailored to meet the individual needs of our clients. Our team of financial advisors are highly experienced and knowledgeable in all key aspects of funds management, from long-term investments and asset protection to liquidity and risk management. We work with our clients throughout the entire process with the objective of structuring portfolios that are optimized for maximum return on investment.

Our fund managers are adept at managing assets across asset classes, including equities (stocks), fixed income (bonds), currencies, treasuries, alternatives, real assets, and commodities. We keep a close eye on market conditions to try to stay ahead of any potential risks or opportunities that may arise. Additionally, we provide complete portfolio analysis so our clients can make informed decisions about where they want to invest their money.
